relationships.subject: mGAT4
relationships.evidence_quote: mGAT4 (encoded by Slc6a11) is another GAT besides GAT1 (encoded by Slc6a1) that functions in GABA reuptake in CNS.

relationships.subject: mGAT4
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of multiple components of the GABAergic system including GAD67, GABA<sub>A</sub> and KCC2 was altered.

relationships.subject: mGAT4
relationships.evidence_quote: mGat4<sup>-/-</sup> mice showed increased pain threshold and hypoalgesia behavior in nociceptive stimulus

key_findings: mGat4 knockout mice showed increased pain thresholds/hypoalgesia, less depression- and anxiety-like behavior, motor incoordination and learning/memory impairments.
mGat4 deletion altered GAD67, GABAA receptor and KCC2 expression with little compensation by mGat1.
